messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands with her back to the camera, then turns her head to the side and places her hands on her hips before lowering them.","camera":"The camera is at a low angle, starting as a medium shot of her upper body and slowly pulling back to a full-body shot.","clothing":"She wears a cream-colored romper with a floral print of pink and yellow flowers and green leaves, featuring a low open back and three-quarter sleeves, along with flat sandals.","hair_color":"Her hair appears dark brown, with the back of her head in shadow.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into two low pigtails tied with light-colored bands.","identity":"A slim woman with a tanned complexion is shown from behind, with her face not visible.","scene":"She stands on a concrete surface at the edge of a calm body of water, with rocks and a wooden post visible in the background under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":["The exact hair color is difficult to determine due to the strong backlighting and shadow on the back of her head."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a city rooftop with buildings, a tower, and a loudspeaker to a concrete edge beside calm water with rocks, a wooden post, and a clear sky, closely matching the reference. The woman remains seen from behind in the same floral romper and pigtails, performing a similar head turn and hands-on-hips motion while the camera pulls back from upper body to full body.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the urban rooftop background with the calm waterfront environment from the reference image while preserving the same woman, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Exact hair color is difficult to confirm due to backlighting and shadow on the back of the head.
unexpected_changes: The person is more strongly backlit and appears darker in the new scene, though this is consistent with the waterfront lighting.
